The harbour bridge reopened to traffic on Tuesday morning after eighteen months of repairs that cost far more than the original estimate, officials said at a press conference held beside the southern pylon.

What changed

Engineers replaced every one of the deck's expansion joints and repainted the steel arch, a job last done in full more than forty years ago. Crews worked mostly at night to keep one lane open.

Commuters said the reopening would cut twenty minutes from the trip & ease pressure on the "old" ferry route, which had been running at capacity since the closure began.

We are glad to have it back, and we are glad it is finished.
